title: Soran, Rawanduz Canyon & Erbil
full_text:
After breakfast, head towards Soran.
Soran — a city surrounded by mountains. In Soran we will get to see the iconic Gali Ali Beg Waterfall, illustrated on one of the Iraqi banknotes. In addition to the beautiful landscape around the city.
Head to Rawanduz, known for its striking scenery, and enjoy the view of the canyon.
See the Hamilton Road — a stunning feat of engineering.
Make a small stop in Shaqlawa for the bustling markets in the city.
Head back to Erbil.
